svg.title: Measured attention weights for 3 March 2021, Lab 4
svg.desc: Heat-map of measured attention weights from Lab 4, dot-product attention model, greedy decoding. Columns are the 12 characters of the source 3 March 2021; rows are the 11 output tokens 2 0 2 1 - 0 3 - 0 3 <eos>. Each row sums to 1. Largest weights per row: 2: 1.00 on 0 (position 10); 0: 1.00 on 0 (position 10); 2: 1.00 on 2 (position 11); 1: 1.00 on 1 (position 12); -: 1.00 on 1 (position 12); 0: 0.99 on space (position 8); 3: 0.72 on r (position 5), 0.28 on c (position 6); -: 0.51 on c (position 6), 0.21 on r (position 5); 0: 1.00 on space (position 2); 3: 0.99 on 3 (position 1); <eos>: 0.89 on 1 (position 12).
svg.text: source position i (one column per character)
output step t (one row per token)
